verdict.rationale: AMD ships an official, open-source SDK stack for the MI355X. ROCm provides math and compute libraries, communication primitives, the HIP runtime, and profiling and debugging tools. HIP C++ and OpenMP programming models are documented, and ROCm-enabled framework recipes cover vLLM and SGLang. The evidence is only brief first-party docs snippets, and an llms.txt exists for agent-friendly docs access. Missing for 10: detail on SDK language bindings and API references (e.g. Python SDK specifics), independent or hands-on corroboration of building against ROCm/HIP on MI355X, and confirmation of MI355X-specific SDK support.
